profile.headline: Computer Science Student at Miami Dade College| Software QA Engineer| Certified Immunizing Pharmacy Technician | Certified Pharmacy Technician | Clinical Support Specialist | Patient Care Representative - II
profile.summary:
I’m an experienced Pharmacy Technician and Patient Care Specialist with over 8 years of experience across hospital, retail, and clinical settings. My background includes working in fast-paced environments like Memorial Regional Hospital, Sam’s Club/Walmart, CVS, and CareMetx, where I developed a strong foundation in patient care, medication management, and healthcare coordination.

I’m passionate about improving patient outcomes, supporting clinical workflows, and ensuring every interaction reflects compassion, accuracy, and professionalism.

🏥 Memorial Regional Hospital – Patient Care Representative (Pharmacy Technician)

Call Center Department

Assisted patients and providers with prescription inquiries, refills, and medication coordination.

Managed high-volume inbound and outbound calls with empathy and attention to detail.

Verified insurance coverage and prior authorizations to ensure timely medication access.

Collaborated with pharmacists and clinical staff to support medication therapy management (MTM).

🏬 Retail Pharmacy Experience – Sam’s Club/Walmart & CVS

Processed prescriptions accurately while maintaining HIPAA compliance.

Delivered excellent customer service by resolving patient concerns and educating them about medication usage.

Handled point-of-sale transactions, inventory management, and third-party billing issues.

Assisted pharmacists with daily workflow and prescription verification support.

💻 Clinical Remote Experience – CareMetx & Arine

CareMetx

Processed prior authorizations (PAs) for specialty and chronic medications.

Communicated with insurance companies and providers to ensure seamless approval and delivery.

Documented case progress and maintained up-to-date patient records.

Arine

Assisted pharmacists in performing Medication Therapy Management (MTM) and Comprehensive Medication Reviews (CMRs).

Supported patients with medication adherence and clinical follow-ups.

Helped identify drug interactions, therapy gaps, and opportunities for patient education.
